crypttab_entries.description: List of encrypted device entries to configure for automatic unlocking at boot.

name.description: Map name for the decrypted device (e.g., 'luks-abc123' → /dev/mapper/luks-abc123).

device.description: Path to the encrypted block device (e.g., /dev/sda2 or UUID=...).

keyfile.description: Path to a keyfile (or '-' to prompt interactively or use no keyfile). Use '-' for no keyfile (e.g., for manual unlock).

options.description: List of cryptsetup options (e.g., ['luks'], ['discard'], ['luks', 'discard']). Common options: luks, luks2, header, keyfile-size, keyfile-offset, try-empty-passphrase.
